7.7.1.1 Runtime Error detection
[SWS_EthTSyn_00145] ⌈If EthTSynMasterSlaveConflictDetection is set to TRUE and if the Time Master receives a Sync message from another Time Master, it shall report a runtime error by calling Det_ReportRuntimeError with error code ETHTSYN_E_TMCONFLICT and discard the received Sync message.⌋(RS_TS_20051)
